verdicts.reason: A: the product is shrunk to a tiny icon floating apart from the circle, with big dead gaps above it and below the CTA. 'WEEKEND ONLY' has dropped from the top to below the fine print, and the legal line is almost as big as the subhead. B: the headline runs edge to edge and sits on the circle, 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' wraps to leave 'only.' alone on a line, and 'WEEKEND ONLY' is also out of order. Still, B makes better use of the tall format, with a larger product and a stronger CTA, so it is slightly the less bad of the two.
